name: Linnea
notes: Both sources: DEF% sands and goblet, CRIT circlet (KQM: CRIT >= DEF%), Golden Frostbound Oath first, Skill > Burst > Normal Attack (KQM: Skill > character level > Burst). KQM leads with Husk of Opulent Dreams, then Aubade of Morningstar and Moon and Silken Moon's Serenade; Game8 names Aubade and Husk both best, so Husk stays first. Goals are Game8's: DEF 2,000+, CRIT Rate 60-70 (65), CRIT DMG 150+, EM 100-200 (150), ER 110-140 with another Geo character and 130-170 solo. 140 is used; KQM's ER is 170-185 for a Burst every rotation and 100 when Burst is cast only when available, so the two sources differ and the confidence is medium. Partners are Geo and Hydro (Lunar-Crystallize), from the kit and Game8's build title.
